faq.a: Aamna is associated with the Arabic form آمنة, whose core sense is safe, secure, free from fear.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aamna?
faq.a: Aamna is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of the same name as aamina/aaminah; associated with Āmina bint Wahb in the sīra tradition.
Yes — the underlying form آمنة is Arabic.
Aamna can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aamna should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. root أ م ن occurs in the Qur'an; آمنة is a normal Arabic feminine form

faq.a: Romanization variants include Aamna, aamna, amna. Script forms are آمنة, آمنه, آمنہ, आमना.

faq.q: Is Aamna a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
